description: Header file defining the H265VaapiVideoDecoderDelegate class, which implements H265 decoding acceleration and VAAPI video decoding delegation for H265 videos using VAAPI on Linux/ChromeOS.

classes.name: H265VaapiVideoDecoderDelegate
classes.description: A class implementing H265 video decoding acceleration and VAAPI delegation for ChromeOS/Linux.

methods.name: H265VaapiVideoDecoderDelegate
methods.description: Constructor initializing the delegate with VAAPI surface handler, wrapper, session update callback, CdmContext, and encryption scheme.

methods.name: CreateH265Picture
methods.description: Creates a new H265 picture object.

methods.name: SubmitFrameMetadata
methods.description: Submits frame metadata including SPS, PPS, slice header, reference pictures, and the picture to the decoder.

methods.name: SubmitSlice
methods.description: Submits a slice of the video stream with associated reference pictures and data.

methods.name: SetStream
methods.description: Sets the stream data and decrypt configuration.

methods.name: IsChromaSamplingSupported
methods.description: Checks if a specific chroma sampling format is supported.
